Rules & controls
  • Unlimited respawns · 3 seconds

Cases & health

2 cyber cases: arrive after 20s, refill 65s after collection. Unlocks last this round and survive death.

Roll: Rare 60% · Epic 30% · Legendary 10%. Damage +6% / +12% / +18%, with faster firing and reloads. Duplicates upgrade at least one tier; maxed weapons are skipped.

Cyber perks: AR tighter fire · shotgun 12 pellets · SMG stronger air steering · sniper pierces one player for 65% damage. Walls still stop shots.

3 health packs: +35 HP, up to 100. Refill after 35s. Full health? Leave it for later.
